attributes.name: Space Safari Drone Light Show - Cambridge
attributes.description:
Experience a spectacular drone light show for the first time in Cambridgeshire! ✨


Witness the night sky filled with hundreds of synchronised drones, creating mesmerising animations with a symphony of light and sound.


Prepare to be amazed with cinematic storytelling in the sky with epic-scale narration by Bafta award-winning TV presenter Michaela Strachan. 🎙️🎶✨🎥


As well as the drone show finale, enjoy a full evening of entertainment including:

🎶 Live Music & Entertainment

🎡 Fairground rides, face painting and street food

Through immersive sound and light, the night sky in Cambridge will see hundreds of drones showcasing this inspiring story of bravery and adventure. 🤩

(Under 3s go FREE, ticket still required)

   
Newmarket Racecourse

Saturday 24th October 2026

✨ The drone show is expected to start between 18:30 and 18:45 (subject to change)

🌌 Hundreds of drones light up the night sky

🎥 Epic storytelling soundtrack

✨ Live Music 

🎡 Fairground rides

🎨 Face painting

🌮 Food stalls

🌿 Eco-friendly

Important Venue Information

Please note that dogs are NOT permitted on site

Important Weather Policy

Drone shows are highly sensitive to weather, and if weather conditions prevent Space Safari from proceeding as planned, the event will be rescheduled to a new date at the same venue.

Tickets are non-refundable in the case of rescheduling due to weather. Contingency dates include but are not limited to Monday 26th, Tuesday 27th & Wednesday 28th October 2026 and ticket holders will be contacted via SMS and email with updates.

By purchasing a ticket, you agree to comply with safety guidelines and accept the possibility of rescheduling the event to the contingency dates.

Parking

Important: Don't forget to book your Parking! (PARKING GOES LIVE AT 10:30AM)

Please note that pre-booking parking is essential to guarantee a parking space on site. Pre-book parking here:

Park The Car Here Booking Platform

attributes.description:
PROJECT HALLOWEEN 🎃 Manchester's Biggest Halloween Event! ❤️‍🔥 10,000 People!


IMPORTANT INFORMATION

This event is NOT Included on the Wristband

To access this event you must have purchased a SINGLE TICKET SEPARATELY or AS A ADD ON. 

ANY person who tries to access the event with a wristband ticket will not get access to the event.


🎃 THE HALLOWEEN PROJECT, Manchesters Biggest Halloween Event 🎃

10,000 STUDENTS! UK'S BIGGEST HALLOWEEN EVENT


🚨 THE SCARIEST. THE WILDEST. THE MOST INSANE HALLOWEEN RAVE. 🚨

👻 ONE NIGHT ONLY at the legendary home of THE WAREHOUSE PROJECT… if you dare. 👻

This isn’t just a Halloween party—it’s a full-blown NIGHTMARE at DEPOT MAYFIELD. For the first time ever, thousands of will descend into the rave of horror.

Halloween is probably the biggest date of the year in the calendar and it doesn't get much better than this for a halloween event.

Don't miss out on tickets, once they are gone, they're gone.

💀 WHAT TO EXPECT? 💀

🔪 Terrifyingly Good DJs – Spine-chilling drops, haunting beats & the hottest music in the game!

🩸 Insane Horror Production – Blood-red lighting, mind-melting visuals, and eerie effects that will take you to the underworld!

🎭 The Freak Show – Expect the unexpected… sinister performers, twisted characters, and haunting surprises lurking in the shadows!

🕷 Thousands of people – Your squad just got bigger… but make sure you keep them close, you'll need your dance partners by your side for this one.

HUGE PRIZES FOR THE BEST DRESSED ON THE NIGHT!!!
